source_text: Fides vestra annuntiatur in universo mundo. Non erubesco Evangelium: virtus enim Dei est in salutem omni credenti, Iudaeo primum et Graeco. Iustitia Dei revelatur ex fide in fidem — iustus ex fide vivit.
thought_title: Faith announced, gospel not ashamed, righteousness from faith
orientation: Origen is quoting Paul's words from Romans about faith being proclaimed, the gospel as God's power, and righteousness revealed from faith.
pass_a_gloss: Faith your [is] announced in [the] whole world. Not I am ashamed [of the] Gospel: power for of God [it] is unto salvation to every [one] believing, to [the] Jew first and [the] Greek. Righteousness of God [is] revealed from faith into faith — [the] righteous [one] from faith lives.

choices.why: Direct address to the Roman believers, preserving the second-person plural possessive
Renders the universal scope of the proclamation literally

choices.english: I am not ashamed of the gospel
choices.why: Preserves the first-person present tense and the negation exactly
rejected: I do not blush at the gospel
I am not embarrassed by the gospel

choices.term: virtus enim Dei est in salutem omni credenti
choices.english: for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes
choices.why: Keeps the explanatory 'for' and the purpose sense of 'in salutem'
rejected: for it is God's power unto salvation for every believer
for the power of God it is into salvation for all believing

choices.term: Iustitia Dei revelatur ex fide in fidem
choices.english: God's righteousness is revealed from faith to faith
choices.why: Uses the required glossary rendering 'God's righteousness' and keeps the prepositional progression
rejected: The justice of God is revealed out of faith into faith
God's justice is revealed from faith to faith

choices.english: the righteous one lives from faith
choices.why: Preserves the noun 'the righteous one' and the source 'from faith' as the basis of life
rejected: the just man lives by faith
he who is righteous lives by faith

pass_b_english: Your faith is announced in the whole world (Romans 1:8). "I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and to the Greek" (Romans 1:16). God's righteousness is revealed from faith to faith; the righteous one lives from faith (Romans 1:17).

problems.quote: "I am not ashamed of the gospel," Paul says
problems.why: Source lacks "Paul says"; Origen quotes Paul directly without attribution marker.
problems.fix: "I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God..."
problems.ruling: Source 'Non erubesco Evangelium' lacks 'Paul says'; translator inserts attribution not in source text.

edits.old: "I am not ashamed of the gospel," Paul says, "for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and to the Greek" (Romans 1:16).
